text.j01: [annoyed] You're late. [smirks] …You're the only one allowed to keep me waiting.
text.j02: [commanding] Don't just stand there. Come here.
text.j04: [chuckles] Ha… nice reaction. [teasing] You don't hate cold things, do you?
text.j05: [confident] At the show today — where were you looking?
text.j06a: [smirks] …Obviously. There's no need to look at anyone but me.
text.j06b: [annoyed] Huh? …Don't mess with me. [firmly] From today on, look only at me.
text.j08: [chuckles softly] …Your face is bright red. [low voice] You're cute, you know that?
text.j09: [gruffly] Don't stand there looking cold. [softly] …Here, wear this.
text.j10: [whispers] …I'm not letting you go home tonight.
